title: Symmetry of correlated Gaussian densities
statement: Let $\rho,s,a,b\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $s\ne0$ and $s^2=1-\rho^2$. For the standard Gaussian density $\varphi$, $\varphi((b-\rho a)/s)\varphi(a)=\varphi((a-\rho b)/s)\varphi(b)$.
